est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Stony Brook University/2026-2027/2026-2027 Stony Brook University Incoming Exchange Fact Sheet (8).pdf#page=4
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from AY 2026-2027 Fall semester exchange estimate on Fact Sheet p.4 divided across a 5-month semester: Living Expenses ($6,089) + Housing Single Room ($7,515) = $13,604/semester / 5 months = $2,720.80 (~$2,721/month); Full Year Living+Housing = $27,208. Excludes $2,143/sem University Fees and $982 Fall / $2,345 AY Health Insurance.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Stony Brook University/2026-2027/2026-2027 Stony Brook University Incoming Exchange Fact Sheet (8).pdf#page=4
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (native USD); Fall 2026 5-month semester Living Expenses ($6,089) + Housing Single Room ($7,515) = $13,604 USD from Fact Sheet p.4 (5 * $2,720.80/mo). Excludes $2,143 University Fees and $982 Health Insurance (Total Exchange Fall 2026 estimate = $16,729).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory SBU Health Insurance (auto-enrolled and billed on SOLAR): $982 for Fall 2026 / $2,345 for Fall 2026 - Spring 2027. Mandatory University Fees: $2,143 for Fall 2026 / $4,287 for AY 2026-2027.

housing_notes.value: Priority on-campus housing across 6 residential facilities within walking distance of classes (each with computing and fitness centers); apply via Housing Portal. AY 2026-27 single room estimate: $7,515 Fall / $15,030 Academic Year; meal plan separate if warranted.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa required (VIS emails admitted students for DS-2019 request; min 12 credits/sem with >= 9 in-person and <= 3 online). Adequate proof of liquid funds meeting or exceeding estimated exchange expenses ($16,729 Fall 2026 / $33,840 AY 2026-27 incl. fees & insurance, or higher per VIS; SBU Coordinator provides tuition-waiver letter for DS-2019).

course_restrictions_note.value: Restricted: HAD, Medicine, Nursing, Dental Medicine, Pharmacology; AMS 325; BUS 301/487/488; CSE 316/320/416 & CSE grad; ECO 108/359; EEO online; EGL 204/301/360/440/441/454; MEC 225/316/317/325/411/440/441; PSY 310; WRT 101/102. Limited access: Arts, Biology, Chemistry, Dance, Political Science, some languages; CSE/ISE max 2/sem; ACC/BUS max 2/sem. Department approves prerequisites; no guaranteed seat enrollment.
